narrative.overview:
The team's brief, binding: keep the yellow tone and the "under construction" image; yellow and white; industrial but modern; nothing round, nothing soft, nothing huge. The build answers with a white sheet under one yellow band. The band, 54px high with a black-and-yellow hazard stripe along its lower edge and a tower-crane mark as the logo, is the one piece of site on every page. Everything below it is a register: hairline rules, square corners, 12 to 15px text, small tracked capitals for labels, tabular figures.

The product principle "where before what" is carried by one device used at two scales. An LV is drawn as a strip of its items in LV order; an item without a finding is a pale grey mark, an item with a finding stands up in its severity colour. On the projects page the strip is 22px high and anonymous (the fingerprint); in the workspace it becomes the LV map, where flagged items carry their item number. Severity is always shape plus colour: Stop is a red circle, Caution a yellow triangle, Note a blue square.

Rejected by the team and not to return: all-yellow pages with heavy black keylines (tiring), the same language made softer with rounded cards and a large headline, and a dark version.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, one yellow band; yellow below the band only for the primary action, index plates, a caution mark and hover.
Hairlines (1px) do the dividing; cards are an outline, never a fill and a shadow.
Square: containers and marks have no radius, controls have 2px.
Small type: body 14px, labels 11px capitals, the largest text on any page is the 30px item number.
The LV as a strip of items with trouble standing up in place, on the projects page and in the workspace.
Three severity signs, shape and colour together, unchanged across every view.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: A full-width yellow surface exists once per page: the band. Below it yellow is a small plate, a button or a mark, never a section background.

rules.name: The Severity Only Rule
rules.body: Red and blue mean Stop and Note (red also: an error or a loss). They are never used for decoration, links or branding.

rules.name: The Hover Is Yellow Rule
rules.body: Hover lightens to pale yellow on rows, and inverts yellow plates and the primary button to ink with yellow text. Selection is ink with white text.

rules.name: The Nothing Huge Rule
rules.body: 30px is the ceiling, and only the item number reaches it. A page title is 24px.

rules.name: The Condensed For Figures Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed appears only on the brand, the two headlines, index plates, the item number and money or dimension figures. Buttons, labels, tags, table cells and item numbers in lists and blocks are Barlow.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every item number, count, quantity and amount is set with tabular figures.

rules.name: The German Stays German Rule
rules.body: LV text is shown as written and marked `lang="de"`; anonymisation tokens are shown in quieter ink with a dotted underline, never styled as errors.

rules.name: The Line Not Lift Rule
rules.body: State is shown by a line or a fill changing colour (120ms), never by a shadow, a blur or a movement.

rules.name: The Round Belongs To The Signs Rule
rules.body: The circle and the rounded square exist as severity signs, and a circle may be drawn where the subject itself is round (a pipe bore in a finding picture). No interface container, button or badge is round or pill-shaped.

dos: Do start every page with the band: yellow, 54px, hazard stripe below, crane mark and "LV CHECK" at the left.
Do keep the ground white and divide with 1px lines (`rule` between rows, `line-2` around controls and cards).
Do keep text between 12 and 15px, labels at 11px 600 capitals with 0.1em tracking, and figures tabular.
Do show severity as sign plus colour: red circle, yellow triangle, blue square, with the count beside it.
Do show an LV as a strip of its items in order, flagged items standing up in their severity colour, wherever an LV is summarised.
Do give a view one yellow primary button; every other action is ink, outline, ghost or a text link.
Do use pale yellow for hover and ink with white text for selection.
Do scale for large screens with body zoom (1.15 from 1700px, 1.4 from 2300px) instead of larger type.
Do say "no file", "no prices", "No reliable price." and "Not quantified" in plain words where there is nothing to show.
donts: Don't fill a page or a section with yellow, or frame sections with heavy black keylines; the team found both tiring.
Don't round anything beyond 2px, and don't use pills, soft cards, shadows, gradients or blur: nothing round, nothing soft.
Don't set anything larger than 30px: nothing huge.
Don't colour the head of a finding card by severity; the head is white and the sign carries it.
Don't use red or blue for anything but severity, errors and a loss.
Don't use Barlow Condensed for buttons, labels, tags or table text.
Don't add a dark version, a 3D picture of a single LV or an illustration; the trade diagram is the only 3D drawing.
Don't translate or restyle German LV text, and don't mark anonymisation tokens as errors.
Don't show an amount without its source, or imply money on a finding that has none.
